42.70582,23.25141|40.headline: Clear Suhodolska River to Prevent Flood
steps: Deploy crew to northern access road and secure perimeter
Trim dense trees and scrub using chainsaws to expose the channel
Use portable hand‑spade and silt‑suction pump to remove debris and restore width to at least 60%
Install temporary sandbags and portable barriers along vulnerable banks
Verify flow clearance and monitor water level until rain passes
42.70582,23.25141|40.access: Reach site via Lulinitsa road; off‑road vehicle can park at the cleared meadow entry.
